title: Footings and anchorage.
officialText:
The footings and anchorage for every scaffold shall be sound and rigid, capable of carrying the
maximum load without excessive settlement or deformation and secure against movement in any direction. Supports such as barrels,
boxes, loose brick, loose stone, or other unstable materials shall not be used.
